# Or Hakerem — Luxury Short-Term Stays in Tel Aviv

> Or Hakerem is a boutique luxury short-term rental and event venue in Kerem HaTeimanim (the Yemenite Quarter), Tel Aviv, Israel, offering two premium apartments for short, medium, and long-term stays plus intimate event hosting with optional kosher services.

## About

Or Hakerem offers two premium apartments for short, medium, and long-term stays, as well as intimate event hosting with optional kosher services. Hospitality is attentive and Shabbat-friendly. Direct bookings are up to 15% cheaper than third-party platforms.

**Address:** 35 Hakovshim Street, Kerem HaTeimanim, Tel Aviv, Israel
**Email:** keremliving@gmail.com
**Phone (Israel):** +972 52 686 9791
**Phone (France):** +33 6 51 17 99 25
**Social:** [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/or_hakerem/)

## Properties

- [Luxury Penthouse with Private Jacuzzi](https://www.orhakerem.com/properties/penthouse-jacuzzi): 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, up to 6 guests; rooftop terrace with private jacuzzi, BBQ, and panoramic Tel Aviv sea views, in a historic building steps from Carmel Market and Banana Beach.
- [Spacious & Cosy Apartment](https://www.orhakerem.com/properties/cozy-studio): 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, up to 4 guests; renovated studio in a historic Ottoman-era building, 2 minutes walk to Banana Beach and Carmel Market.

## Location Context

Kerem HaTeimanim is a historic neighborhood in central Tel Aviv, minutes from:

- Carmel Market (Shuk HaCarmel) — 400m
- Banana Beach — 600m
- Nachalat Binyamin arts market — 450m
- Rothschild Boulevard — 10 min walk
- Tel Aviv city center — walkable

## Services

Concierge services include grocery delivery, private transportation & airport transfers, babysitting, event planning, on-demand cleaning, and restaurant reservations. Shabbat support (keys, hot plates, timers) and kosher meal arrangements available.

## Content

The Or Hakerem blog covers Tel Aviv travel guides, neighborhood insights for Kerem HaTeimanim, Shabbat-friendly travel tips, and advice for guests planning stays in the city.
